== Biography ==
Robert was born around 1800 to [[Glasgow-1142|James Glasgow (1750-abt.1803)]] and [[Simpson-19200|Jean Simpson (abt.1754-)]]<ref>"Scotland, Civil Registration, 1855-1875, 1881, 1891", FamilySearch (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:X9GN-9CZJ : Wed Dec 18 09:56:33 UTC 2024), Entry for Robert Glasgow and James Glasgow, 21 Nov 1855.
</ref>

Captain Robert Glasgow died at Port Glasgow on 21 Nov 1855 (Greenock Advertiser 23.11.1855)

Potential grandson, Glasgow-3419
Might be the same person as [[Glasgow-1598|Robert Glasgow (bef.1799-)]]
